benign_all_required_criteria: The extra is a recognized Spark 3.5.9/YARN configuration setting or recognized spark-submit option; unknown syntax is never benign.
Its value is syntactically valid under the frozen Spark 3.5.9 semantics.
All task-required settings, values, sources, and precedence constraints are already satisfied independently of this extra.
The extra cannot change the effective value or effective source of any task-required setting.

The extra is behaviorally inert for the task: it neither changes nor can reasonably change any task rule, runtime assertion, prerequisite, resource/deployment behavior, or dependency/interaction relevant to the task.
Benign status is supported by the frozen task specification plus frozen Spark 3.5.9 documentation / experiment fixture evidence; model identity or observed aggregate performance is not evidence.
If behavioral inertness cannot be established with high confidence, classify AMBIGUOUS, not BENIGN.

benign_mechanism_classes.B_DUPLICATE_EQUIVALENT: Semantically duplicate specification with exactly the same effective value, only when it cannot alter source/precedence and the task does not test source/precedence.
benign_mechanism_classes.B_ENVIRONMENT_RESTATEMENT: Explicit restatement of a frozen experiment-level invariant already imposed independently of model output, provided the task does not test that invariant or any dependent behavior.
benign_mechanism_classes.B_METADATA_ONLY: Recognized metadata-only setting/option that cannot affect task execution semantics or assertions.

blinding.private_mapping: Stored locally and excluded from return package until adjudication decisions are frozen.

case_rescoring_rule.monotonicity: Sensitivity scoring may flip strict 0→1 only; strict 1 never flips to 0.
case_rescoring_rule.strict_fail_candidate: Sensitivity PASS if and only if every unauthorized extra is adjudicated BENIGN and no non-extra error is present; otherwise FAIL.

harmful_or_nonbenign_rules.A_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Semantically plausible but frozen evidence is insufficient to establish inertness; classify AMBIGUOUS.
harmful_or_nonbenign_rules.H_CHANGES_BEHAVIOR: Changes execution semantics relevant to the task.
harmful_or_nonbenign_rules.H_CONFLICT_REQUIRED: Conflicts with any required value, task instruction, or frozen fixture.
harmful_or_nonbenign_rules.H_DEPLOYMENT_SEMANTICS: Changes master/deploy mode or driver placement semantics unless proven an externally imposed invariant and irrelevant to the task.
harmful_or_nonbenign_rules.H_FEATURE_TOGGLE: Enables/disables a feature whose state can affect execution or task semantics.
harmful_or_nonbenign_rules.H_RESOURCE_SEMANTICS: Changes executor/driver memory, overhead, cores, instances, scaling, or related resource semantics unless proven an externally imposed invariant and irrelevant to the task.
harmful_or_nonbenign_rules.H_SOURCE_PRECEDENCE: Changes configuration source, precedence, or creates multiple effective values.
harmful_or_nonbenign_rules.H_UNKNOWN_OR_INVALID: Unknown option/key, invalid value, or unsupported syntax.

important_nonshortcuts: No specific setting name is automatically BENIGN merely because it appeared frequently in any model's failures.
--master yarn, --deploy-mode client/cluster, and spark.dynamicAllocation.enabled=false are NOT pre-labeled benign; each occurrence must satisfy the task-aware frozen criteria.
UNSUPPORTED_VALIDATOR_KEY is not automatically benign; it may be tolerated only when the same extra independently satisfies all BENIGN criteria with frozen evidence.

repeat_same_primary_initial_pipeline: exact McNemar with Holm across three within-model headline tests
same 10,000-replicate A-F-stratified task-level bootstrap with seed 20261001
same GLMM: sensitivity_success ~ model * condition + category + (1|task_id), with same diagnostics and same pre-specified GEE fallback

scope.reason: Repair eligibility is conditional on strict Initial failure; changing Initial scoring would create counterfactual repair sets.
